result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but one restaurant title in the 'Popular right now' section is truncated ('Tokumaru Ramer'), which appears to be a text-clipping defect rather than intentional edge clipping.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramer' in the 'Popular right now' section appears truncated/clipped mid-word, even though there is horizontal space available before the rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to use the full available width or apply a proper ellipsis with sufficient space so the full name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is readable.
